steps.question: What does ‘courtyard’ mean?
options: an open space surrounded by buildings
an amusing drawing in a magazine

steps.question: How did Appu drink a bucketful of water?

questionMeaning.hi: अप्पू ने बाल्टी भर पानी कैसे पिया?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Appu ne baalti bhar paani kaise piya?

options: He sucked it all up from the bucket at one go.
He drank it slowly with a glass.
He spilled it on the ground.
steps.answer: He sucked it all up from the bucket at one go.
steps.modelAnswer: Appu sucked up all the water from the bucket with his trunk, at one go.

modelMeaning.hi: अप्पू ने अपनी सूँड से बाल्टी का सारा पानी एक ही बार में खींच लिया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Appu ne apni soond se baalti ka saara paani ek hi baar mein kheench liya.

steps.question: Where has she seen the elephants before?

questionMeaning.hi: उसने पहले हाथी कहाँ देखे हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Usne pehle haathi kahan dekhe hain?

options: In the movies and in cartoon shows on T.V.
In the zoo near her school.
steps.answer: In the movies and in cartoon shows on T.V.
steps.modelAnswer: She has seen elephants in the movies and in cartoon shows on T.V.

modelMeaning.hi: उसने हाथी फ़िल्मों में और टीवी पर कार्टून शो में देखे हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Usne haathi filmon mein aur TV par cartoon show mein dekhe hain.
